name: AUIB Academic Advisor
description: Degree planning for AUIB students: progress per requirement, a term-by-term plan to graduation and explained elective suggestions.

ADVISOR_ADMIN_TOKEN.description: The master token (ADR 0009): adds and removes admins in the admin page (People tab) and opens it in an emergency. Generated here; keep it secret. The key for sign-in codes is derived from it.

ADVISOR_DATA_KEY.description: Optional: opens the sealed course data for the import (ADR 0008); only the maintainers' key works. Leave it empty to start with an empty catalog that admins fill in the admin page.

ADVISOR_MAIL_MODE.description: Sign-in codes are emailed through SMTP.

ADVISOR_SMTP_HOST.description: The mail server that sends sign-in codes, such as AUIB's SMTP relay or smtp.mailgun.org.

ADVISOR_SMTP_USERNAME.description: SMTP user name. Leave empty for a relay that does not need a login.

ADVISOR_SMTP_PASSWORD.description: SMTP password or API key. Leave empty for a relay that does not need a login.

ADVISOR_SMTP_FROM.description: The sender, for example: AUIB Academic Advisor <advisor@auib.edu.iq>

ADVISOR_AUTO_IMPORT.description: Import the course catalog and new program packages in each release.

ADVISOR_AUTO_IMPORT_ACCEPT_WARNINGS.description: Publish packages whose only findings are warnings, such as an unconfirmed catalog year.

ADVISOR_WORKERS.description: API worker processes. 2 fits a 512 MB dyno; use 1 if Heroku reports memory errors (R14).

ADVISOR_DB_POOL_SIZE.description: Database connections each API worker keeps open (Heroku's smallest plans allow 20 in all).

ADVISOR_DB_MAX_OVERFLOW.description: Extra connections each worker may open at busy moments.

ADVISOR_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE.description: Planning requests per minute per visitor.
